items.title: Southern Co (SO) Cleared PSC Review for 3.2GW of OpenAI Demand. Can Data Centers Lower Customer Bills Without Raising Grid Risk?
items.summary: The Southern Company (NYSE:SO) cleared the Georgia Public Service Commission review process for Georgia Power to serve an OpenAI data center project in Effingham County, Georgia. The 25-year agreement covers approximately 3.2 gigawatts of new demand. items.title: 3 Utility Dividend Stocks Built to Keep Paying in Any Economy
items.summary: Not every dividend stock survives a recession with its payout intact, but regulated utilities operate under a different set of rules entirely. These three have raised dividends for decades by design, and the mechanics behind that streak are worth understanding before the next downturn tests your portfolio.

items.title: Is Southern Company Stock Underperforming the Dow?
items.summary: Southern Company has underperformed the Dow over the past year, and analysts are cautious about the stock’s prospects.

items.title: Why High-Yield Baby Bonds Offer Income Investors a Rare Opportunity
items.summary: Have a look at an obscure corner of the corporate bond market that is offering high yields and good credit quality.  Yields are higher than those on many preferred stock issues that also trade on the NYSE.

items.title: No ETFs Required: How a 64-Year-Old Built a $5,700 Monthly Paycheck From Five Dividend Stocks
items.summary: Most retirees assume hitting a $68,400 annual income floor demands either a massive nest egg or risky high-yield instruments, but five ordinary dividend stocks across five sectors challenge both assumptions in ways the math makes hard to ignore.

items.title: Vistra Stock Is Down, But Is This Power Producer's Dip An Opportunity?
items.summary: The company is chasing the data center boom, but after a pullback in the shares, you have to weigh a strong recovery record against some very real market pressures.

items.title: PG&E Stock Is Priced For A Decision It Does Not Make
items.summary: PG&E's cash-flow multiple sits far below the market's, and the company says its capital plan is premised on how California resolves wildfire liability.

items.title: Forget XLU: These 3 Utility Dividend Stocks Offer More Exposure to AI
items.summary: XLU gives you exposure to over 30 utilities, but the AI data-center boom is quietly concentrating inside just a handful of them, and owning the fund means paying for a lot of names that will miss the surge entirely.
